notes.title: Demo Release — Unsealed Pact is Now Playable!
notes.content:
[p][b]The pact has been unsealed![/b][/p]
We’re excited to announce that the [b]free demo[/b] of [i]Unsealed Pact[/i] is now available to play on Steam. This is your first chance to dive into the world we’ve been building and experience the game’s unique twist on roguelike deckbuilding.

[p][b]What’s inside the demo:[/b][/p]
[list]
[]🧙 [b]1 Hero[/b] — experiment with their unique playstyle
[]⚔️ [b]2 Acts[/b] — battle through branching paths and encounters
[*]🃏 [b]Deck, Relics & Summons[/b] — the core systems are ready to test
[/list]

This is just the beginning — more heroes, acts, and challenges await in the full game. 

[p][b]We need your feedback![/b][/p]
Try the demo, share your impressions, and join our community:
👉 [url=https://discord.gg/KkS3kxjhE4]Join the Discord[/url]

Thank you for supporting [i]Unsealed Pact[/i]. We hope you enjoy the demo — and remember: [b]every choice unseals your fate.[/b]
